text:
Hi everyone,

I am Kawika, and I work mornings at a bakery in town, so I am usually home by two in the afternoon. On weekends I enjoy surfing and cooking big pots of chili to share.

I like a clean kitchen, so I wash my dishes right away and I am happy to make a chore chart for the bathroom and trash. I keep quiet hours after ten and use headphones for music. If I want friends over, I will always ask first.

If we ever disagree, I would rather talk it out calmly and listen to your side. I will pay my share of the rent and utilities on time every month.

I am excited to meet you all!

See you soon,
Kawika

Hello all,

My name is Priya, and I am a nurse who works three night shifts a week, so I sleep during some daytime hours. In my free time I enjoy reading, yoga and hiking.

I am tidy and I clean the shared spaces I use. I am glad to split chores like taking out the trash and cleaning the bathroom. Because of my schedule, I appreciate quiet during the day when I am sleeping, and I keep noise low when I come home late. Guests are fine with a heads-up.

If a problem comes up, I prefer to talk about it early so we can find a compromise. I always pay bills on time, and I can set up a shared app to split utilities.

I am looking forward to meeting you. Thanks!

Priya

Aloha future roommates,

I'm Kiana. I work at the movie theater on weekend nights, and I like drawing and playing volleyball. I'm pretty easy to get along with.

I will keep the kitchen clean and do my dishes. I can take turns with the bathroom and trash. I use headphones for music, and I will ask before I have friends over.

If we have a problem, I want to talk about it and work it out together. I will always pay my share of the rent and bills on time.

I'm happy to meet you all. Mahalo!

Kiana

Hi everyone,

My name is Kekoa. I am a mechanic, and I work weekdays from seven to four. On weekends I go fishing with my cousins, and I like cooking dinner for friends.

I grew up in a house with five siblings, so I know how important it is to clean up after yourself. I am happy to split chores and keep the kitchen and bathroom tidy. I go to bed early, so I like a quiet house after ten, and guests are fine if we talk about it first.

My family uses hoʻoponopono to work through problems, so I believe in talking things out honestly. I will pay my share of the bills on time every month.

I can't wait to meet you.

Mahalo,
Kekoa

Hi everyone,

I'm Noah and I work at the surf shop in the afternoons. I like skateboarding and video games.

I clean up after myself and I do my dishes. I will pay my share of the rent on time. I usually go to sleep around eleven so I'm pretty quiet at night.

I'm excited to live with you guys.

Thanks,
Noah
